tasks.title: Profiles and config rendering
tasks.summary: Add the six profile files and the engine that picks one and lists candidates, and render a config holding active keys, commented keys, adequacy, baseline tables and worktree setup.
acceptance: test_profiles covers marker detection, conditions and candidate order for all six
a rendered config parses back through parse_config, including a regex with backslashes
the generic profile with no markers renders the same default tables as before
each profile's regex matches a sample of its tool's output

tasks.title: ws init runs and records commands
tasks.summary: Make ws init try candidates on a clean tree, write only what it verified, keep the rest visible as comments, and record known findings in a project baseline that tasks read.
acceptance: a passing command becomes an active key
a lint that fails with parsed findings becomes active and its findings are recorded
a failing test becomes a comment with the reason
a missing tool is not run and becomes a comment
a command that changes the tree becomes a comment
a later candidate is used when the first fails
a task passes on known findings from the project baseline and a workstream baseline overrides it
a dirty tree is refused, and --no-run writes only comments
an existing config is left alone

tasks.title: Tiers
tasks.summary: Make lite, standard and full mean something: a lite plan template, releaseImpact and the bump keyed on the full tier, and lines in ws-plan and ws-coordinate.
acceptance: a lite workstream has only a plan and a queue, and settles
a full workstream needs a runbook and requires releaseImpact
status and close report the bump only for a full workstream
a lite workstream in a releasing project doesn't ask for releaseImpact
the audit still passes

tasks.title: ws doctor
tasks.summary: Add a read-only health check, and --run to judge the commands against the baseline.
acceptance: doctor passes on a good repo and writes nothing
it fails on a broken config, a missing integration branch and an invalid queue
it warns on a missing tool, an uncommitted config and a stray adequacy key
--run fails on a new finding and passes on known ones
it works outside a project and says to run init

tasks.title: End-to-end proof on all six profiles
tasks.summary: Prove init on a fixture repo per profile and with real tools where installed, take one through a full run with the fake agent, and update the docs.
acceptance: init works on a fixture repo for each of the six profiles
a repo with failing lint adopts, and a task then passes on the known findings and fails on a new one
real cargo, npm and gradle repos adopt where those tools exist
a stubbed repo goes from init to close with the fake agent
the plan's status table and README say what is true

scope.rule: Nothing here may name a stack in Python or depend on a tool being installed.
